product: Cropped public-source inputs and derived feature tables, no independent causal labels

sentinel2_processing.reflectance_scale_and_offsets: Per-scene STAC metadata with ESA processing-baseline fallback, recorded in sentinel2/scene_audit.json
sentinel2_processing.index_filter: NDVI and NDMI within [-1,1], finite EVI; valid reflectance range (-0.05,1.2)
sentinel2_processing.selection: 5 distinct acquisition dates/month, scene cloud<40%, one AOI-covering tile/date
sentinel2_processing.cloud_caution: Class 7 remains (unclassified). Tile cloud cover is not AOI-specific.

temporal_features: Difference from previous valid observation of the same common-grid pixel; positive elapsed time required
environment: 08:00 UTC daily snapshot with trailing context; no prior-date padding, so first windows have missing values
split: Indicative 500 m spatial blocks, 30% held out, seed 42. Does not guarantee independent samples.
integration: Pixel centers assigned to predicted FTW fields; separate MODIS context and EnMAP metadata
licenses_and_citations: See README.md and retained source metadata
enmap_status: Matching scene identified; image/XML download redirected to DLR login; no image data included
